verses.text: Brothers and sisters, if someone is caught in a sin, you who live by the Spirit should gently help that person back. But watch yourselves, or you may also be tempted.
Carry each other's heavy loads. In this way you will obey the law of Christ.
If anyone thinks he is important when he is not, he is fooling himself.
Each person should test his own actions. Then he can be proud of himself, without comparing himself with someone else.
Each person must carry his own load.
Those who are taught God's word should share all good things with their teacher.
Do not be fooled. No one can make a fool of God. A person reaps whatever he sows.
Whoever sows to please his sinful nature will reap ruin from it. But whoever sows to please the Spirit will reap eternal life from the Spirit.
Let us not get tired of doing good. If we do not give up, we will reap a harvest at the right time.
So whenever we have the chance, let us do good to everyone, and most of all to the family of believers.
See what large letters I use as I write to you with my own hand!
Those who want to look good to others are trying to force you to be circumcised. They only do it so that they will not be attacked for the cross of Christ.
Even those who are circumcised do not keep the law themselves. They want you to be circumcised so that they can boast about it.
But I will never boast about anything except the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ. Through the cross, the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.
Being circumcised or not means nothing. What matters is being made a new creation.
Peace and mercy to all who follow this rule, and to God's Israel.
From now on, let no one cause me trouble. I carry on my body the scars that show I belong to Jesus.
Brothers and sisters, may the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
